subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a core Control UI `audio.transcribe` Gateway method for editable composer dictation, provided this PR is ported to the current chat UI and proven end to end before merge?
rationale: The implementation is a useful core feature, but it adds an authenticated browser-to-Gateway microphone audio path and relies on provider credentials/local transcriber execution, so the permanent product and security boundary needs maintainer intent rather than automation-only judgment.

options.title: Port and prove Gateway-backed dictation
options.body: Require the contributor or maintainer to rebase onto `ui/src/pages/chat/*`, fix the accessibility finding, and add redacted proof of recording, Gateway transcription, and draft insertion before merge.

options.title: Accept a narrower follow-up only
options.body: Keep the paired issue open and ask for a smaller fresh PR against current main if this branch is too costly to port cleanly.

options.title: Reject core dictation for now
options.body: Close or pause the PR if maintainers decide editable dictation should wait for a broader WebChat voice/provider product direction.

recommendation.title: Port and prove Gateway-backed dictation
recommendation.body: Require the contributor or maintainer to rebase onto `ui/src/pages/chat/*`, fix the accessibility finding, and add redacted proof of recording, Gateway transcription, and draft insertion before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the prior server-side dictation implementation and is the strongest history signal for the Gateway-backed voice boundary.
